rules: Only direct method summaries and their events scanned; original/archives/tar/restart traces are not independent experiments
Exact duplicate event bytes are alias-linked across original and reused directories
Same task IDs under different budgets/source recipes/protocols must not be merged automatically
Aggregates are references to existing results, never extra observations
Completed does not imply optimizer convergence, independence, blind evaluation or method adoption
Main-table missing entries and pending jobs remain explicit; negative/exploratory results retained
